segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Jordan at Northline Packaging. Email is jordan.ellis@northlinepkg.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I have Northline Packaging pulled up in the admin console. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add three more seats for the operations team. We’re at 42 now, and we need 45 total before Monday, August 12.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure. You’re on the annual Business plan, billed through March 31, 2025. The prorated amount for three seats through the end of the term is $486.75. Do you want those added today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, please. Same billing contact and same purchase order, PO-1847.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I’ve added the three seats. You should now see 45 available seats in the admin console. The billing tool generated invoice 77138 for $486.75 against PO-1847.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to assign them, or are they just available?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: They’re available now. An admin can go to Users, then Invite users, and send the three invitations. Your admins are you, Priya Shah, and Miguel Torres.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s right. I see 45 seats now. Thanks, that was it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. I’ll close this out under ticket 528416, and you’ll get a confirmation email in a minute.
